What I offer

Services

01
1:1 Kickboxing & Muay Thai Coaching
Personal sessions tailored to your pace, goals, and skill level. All pads and equipment provided.
02
Boxing Fundamentals for Beginners
No experience needed. Learn movement, technique, and confidence from day one.
03
Mobile Personal Training
I come to you — at home, a local park, or wherever works. Your schedule, your environment.
04
Group & Family Sessions
Bring a friend, partner, or the whole family. Suitable for all ages and fitness backgrounds.
05
Private Martial Arts Gym
Located in Lidcombe, the gym is equipped with boxing bags, safe floor mats, and available for exclusive use away from the public.
06
Quick and Effective Workouts for Busy People
No gym membership. No commute. Just you, the park, and 60 minutes that sets up your whole day. I come to you — sessions run early mornings at your local park, designed for busy professionals and parents who want to move, feel strong, and start the day right.
